core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gonca corresponds to the Turkish form gonca (Turkish gonca 'bud, blossom' < Persian غنچه (ghonche)). Its core sense is bud, rosebud. Gonca is the Turkish feminine name gonca 'bud, unopened flower, blossom', borrowed from Persian غنچه (ghonche), the same word recorded as ghuncha above. The source gave عونقة (a different Arabic word) as the form and glossed it 'joyful, happy'; the name is Turkish and its sense is 'bud'.
